name: 85007 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85007 (Phoenix) has 118 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85007 (Phoenix) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85007 (Phoenix) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
